one_line: Tell the family moment in large word-by-word Hebrew text over calm real footage, with key words in big yellow.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 wide, static: a toddler in a white romper walks toward the camera on a park path holding a book cover in front of her face. 0:01 text "שאני רוצה לשמור", 0:02 "לנצח." in large yellow. No speech.
q1_hook.why: A toddler walking at the lens with a book hiding her face is a cute image with motion (H1, K1), and the text states an emotional wish but starts mid-sentence, leaving a gap to close (H5). No voice, no brand or product claim in 3 s (H4, H2 not met).

beats.what: A toddler walks toward the camera holding the book cover up; "שאני רוצה לשמור", "לנצח."
beats.why: An emotional wish over a cute moving image

beats.what: On a lawn a woman lifts a baby up, then sits with her; "כמו הרגעים האלה", "משפחתי"
beats.why: Introduces the family and the warm mood

beats.what: A man walks in with a dog and the book under his arm; "הדשא", "וסביב הספר."
beats.why: The book arrives as a small surprise

beats.what: The family opens the book on the grass, the toddler touches it, the dog joins; "פוגשת", "הכלבה"
beats.why: The first reaction to the book

beats.what: Close-up of the cover; the father points at the animals and the girl character; "לראות את החיות"
The toddler on the father's lap as he turns pages; "הוא לא סתם ספר", "סיפור שלם עם השם"
beats.why: The key claim, her name is inside, lands here

beats.what: Father, toddler and dog read together; "מתמלאים גאווה"
beats.why: The parents' pride is the emotional peak

beats.what: Top-down: the toddler alone opens the book on the grass; "טוב שיכולנו להביא"
beats.why: A closing image of the child with the book

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None. The caption is a feeling and a tag; a parent might send it to a partner, but nothing asks for a comment, save, share or tag.
q2_flow.why: A small story in text, a wish, a family on the grass, the book as the surprise, the child's reaction, has a clear arc (K2). The wish opens a gap that "הוא לא סתם ספר" closes at 0:27 (H5). The 0:14 to 0:24 stretch repeats one scene (R3).

q3_cta.what: None in the video or the caption. The last text seen is "טוב שיכולנו להביא" (0:41). Caption: a feeling, "המתכון לאושר אמיתי", "בשיתוף @mebook.ai" and one hashtag.
q3_cta.why: No next step: no brand name on screen, no link, code or comment word, so a viewer can only find the book through the tag (C6, C3 not used). It uses no engagement bait (C2), which suits a keepsake story but leaves nothing to act on.

q4_shown.what: A toddler holding up the book cover (0:00); a family and a dog opening and reading the book on the grass (0:14 to 0:41); a cover close-up (0:24); a page with the girl character (0:30). No brand name, price or ordering step.
q4_shown.why: The book is in a child's hands from the first frame and is opened and read throughout (S1, K5, K8). The claim that her name is inside the story is only written, and the page text is not legible, so the personalising is not seen (S2, S8 not met). Her face and name appear (S5).

q5_edit.what: About 8 takes in 43 s, 3 to 10 s each, mostly static, straight cuts at about 0:03, 0:09, 0:14, 0:24. Word-by-word text narration, key words large and yellow. No speech. Ends on a top-down shot of the toddler with the book.
q5_edit.why: Long takes under a text story suit it, and the large yellow words give rhythm (E2). With no voice, all meaning is in text that changes every 1 to 2 s (E4, T2). It ends on the book (R4), but 43 s is long for one feeling (R2).

q6_topic.what: A family keepsake story: parents and a toddler open a personalised book outdoors, told in text, with her name inside the story. Serves parents who want a memory or gift.
q6_topic.why: A warm family story with a character, a want and a payoff builds a feeling (K2, K1). A dog and parents add charm. No occasion or gift is named (K7 not met), and nothing says how the book is made or ordered.

q7_filmed.what: Static wide and medium shots on a lawn (0:00 to 0:24), then handheld close-ups over the father's shoulder and top-down. Bright sun, hard shadows, blue sky. A mother, a father, a toddler, a dog.
q7_filmed.why: Real family footage in daylight looks homemade and warm (H8, F7). The book is tiny in the wide shots until 0:14 and its page text is unreadable in close-ups (F4). Strong sun adds hard shadows (F7). Subtitles sit at 71 to 77% of the frame (F2).

q8_text.on_screen: A narration in word-by-word text, white with key words in large yellow, centred at about 71 to 77% of the frame height: "שאני רוצה לשמור" (0:01), "לנצח." (0:02), "כמו הרגעים האלה," (0:04), "הוא לא סתם ספר," (0:27), "מסע" (0:28), "סיפור שלם עם השם" (0:30), the child's name in large yellow (0:31), "טוב שיכולנו להביא" (0:41). No headline, no CTA, no brand name.
q8_text.caption: "הרגעים הקטנים שהופכים לזיכרונות גדולים." Four short lines: a feeling, "המתכון לאושר אמיתי", "בשיתוף @mebook.ai", one hashtag "#יוצרתתוכןלעסקים". No product word, question or CTA.
q8_text.why: The text story works with no sound (T1), with large yellow key words (T2), but one-to-three-word cards last about 1 s and sit in the bottom 35% (T5, T4). The caption has no product word and one business hashtag (T7); the disclosure is its third line (T8).

weak_points: No brand name on screen and no CTA; the text starts mid-sentence at 0:01; sentences cut into one-word cards; unreadable pages, so the name claim is unseen; text in the bottom 35%; the child's name written large; her face shown.
lumebook_takeaway: Tell one family moment in large Hebrew text over a calm phone shot of the book in hands, hold one personalised page readable, and end with a CTA.
not_verified: Audio and music (cannot hear; the transcript shows no speech). Whether the family is the creator's. The last 1.6 s (the sheets stop at 0:41, so any brand mention or CTA at the very end is unseen). Whether the name is legible on any page. Whether a word is missing before the first text at 0:01. Correction to src/coded: the first text appears at 0:01, not in the first frame; the child's name appears in large yellow at 0:31.
